headline: Approved site plans for 1308 Elm Street, 285 Manchester Street, and 231 Woodland Avenue; continued gaming facility and fueling station items to August 5.
summary: Approved site plans for 1308 Elm Street, 285 Manchester Street, and 231 Woodland Avenue, and subdivisions at 111 Villa Street and 30 Dawson Avenue. A motion to approve 231 Woodland Avenue with an added façade condition failed, and a later motion approved it without the canopy and front door recommendations. Items at 1279 South Willow Street, 1265 South Willow Street, and Gold Street were continued to August 5, 2026.
decisions: Continued SP2026-010, a site plan for a charitable gaming facility at 1279 South Willow Street and nearby lots, to August 5, 2026.
Continued CU2026-004, a parking reduction tied to phased construction, to August 5, 2026.
Continued S2026-011, a lot line adjustment at 1265 South Willow Street and 55 John E. Devine Drive, to August 5, 2026.
Continued SP2026-011, a fueling station redevelopment at 1265 South Willow Street, to August 5, 2026.
Continued CU2026-005, a request to reduce parking from 19 to 14 spaces at 1265 South Willow Street, to August 5, 2026.
Postponed the completeness determination for S2026-012, a subdivision at 103 Ray Street (motion carried).
Approved CU2026-007, a parking reduction to eight spaces at 285 Manchester Street.
Approved waivers from Subdivision and Site Plan Regulations 8.3(C) and 8.11 for 285 Manchester Street.
Approved SP2026-009, converting a funeral home at 285 Manchester Street into a nine-unit building with eight parking spaces.
Approved a landscape plan waiver for 231 Woodland Avenue (SP2026-013).
Motion to approve SP2026-013 at 231 Woodland Avenue with an added façade condition failed for lack of a second.
Approved SP2026-013 for a landscape contractor's office at 231 Woodland Avenue, without the canopy and front door recommendations.
Approved S2026-013, a subdivision of 111 Villa Street into two lots.
Approved S2026-014, a subdivision of 30 Dawson Avenue into two lots.
Approved SP2026-012, redevelopment of 1308 Elm Street into a six-story building with 51 residential units.
Found that six applications have no regional impact, need no regional review, and need no Conservation Commission review.
Approved the minutes of the June 18, 2026 meeting, with one abstention.
